Ben Sidran has made a significant contribution to American culture as a pianist, vocalist, songwriter, radio broadcaster, author, and record producer.
His astute observations on society have generated a distinctive “Ben Sidran”
Ben was interviewed via Zoom on November 15, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Ben Sidran with me this morning, and 9:00 your time, so thanks for starting out — did you have your coffee I hope?
No, I was going to get it and the next thing I knew the time ran over me and so I’m going to really freeform it here.

Okay. Well that’s my motto. I had to practice this little introduction I have for you, so here goes. There might be a question at the end. Ben Sidran is, or was, a radio and television presenter, author, jazz and rock keyboardist, record producer, composer, performer, label owner, teacher, music critic, interviewer, and I’m going to add sociologist and father of a musician.
